title: 14 New MSFS Releases! Real Airline Schedules, A310 Routes & Alaska Bush Rescue
description:
Ready to expand your airline roster or take on high-altitude executive jet challenges in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020? The Marketplace just delivered 14 brand-new releases headlined by business jet flight challenges, classic widebody routes, structured airline operations, and massive real-world fleet schedule overhauls from VA Systems.

In this marketplace breakdown, we skip the storefront clutter and organize these arrivals into clear categories with key aircraft compatibility notes and prerequisite warnings to help you pick your next departure fast:

✈️ COMMERCIAL ROTATIONS & EXECUTIVE JET CHALLENGES (PERFECT FLIGHT)
Take command of pre-briefed airline legs and high-elevation business jet approaches:

• 12 Legs – Vistara Fall 2026: Command 12 scheduled IFR airline rotations across the Indian subcontinent. Configured with a dedicated Vistara livery for the default Asobo Airbus A320neo, complete with simulated in-flight events, authentic audio, and multi-language flight documentation.
• A310: Condor Route: Tackle 12 demanding high-altitude routes (FL330–FL350) connecting Buenos Aires to regional capitals and the rugged extremes of Argentine Patagonia. Features the classic Condor scheme (Prerequisite: Requires the iniBuilds A310-300).
• Longitude Captain – Flight Challenges: Push your twin-jet executive flying skills across 12 European and North American routes for the Cessna Citation Longitude—including technical valley and altiport arrivals into Innsbruck (LOWI), Samedan (LSZS), and Sion (LSGS).

🌐 AIRLINE FLEET SCHEDULES & GLOBAL HUB TRAFFIC (VA SYSTEMS)
Eliminate empty skies and inject verified Summer 2026 airline schedules directly into your flight log:

• Summer 2026 Fleet Schedules: Dedicated real-world route packages and company liveries covering Aegean Airlines, Copa Airlines, IndiGo, Royal Jordanian, and Dutch favorite Transavia.
• International Hub Overhauls: Regional traffic injections bringing true-to-life scheduled airline variety to Dublin Airport (EIDW), Harry Reid Las Vegas (KLAS), Beirut–Rafic Hariri (OLBA), Hanoi Noi Bai (VVNB), and Canberra (YSCB).

🏔️ STORY-DRIVEN BUSH ADVENTURES (SIMPLE MISSION)
• White River: Lost Signal: Step into the boots of a bush pilot navigating the treacherous Alaskan wilderness across a 10-leg narrative campaign. Search for a vanished scientific expedition, drop critical survival supplies, navigate remote valleys, and scout a precarious glacial lake hemmed in by failing ice dams.

Whether you're lining up a heavy Airbus approach into Patagonia, managing complex executive descents through the Alps, or searching frozen valleys in Alaska, these additions bring purposeful flight planning back to your simulator.

Which of these activity packs or schedule overhauls are you loading up first? Drop your pick in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2020 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
